title_en: Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House v. Beijing Haidian District Audio & Video Art Service Agency — dispute over infringement of exclusive publication right of audio tapes
keywords_en: Civil; Copyright infringement dispute; First instance; Basic People's Court; Beijing Municipality; Legal person; General Principles of the Civil Law; Exclusive right of publication and distribution; Unauthorized reproduction of audio tapes; Tort liability; Partially upheld; Exclusive publication right of audio tapes; Unauthorized reproduction; Distribution and sale; Dispute over infringement of exclusive publication right of audio tapes
full_text_en:
Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House v. Beijing Haidian District Audio & Video Art Service Center — dispute over infringement of exclusive publication right of audio tapes

Plaintiff: Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House.

Legal representative: Wang Shuzhong, Director of Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House.

Agent ad litem: Yang Runge, Editorial Department Director of Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House.

Agent ad litem: Jin Jianmin, Lawyer of Dalian Foreign Economic Law Firm.

Defendant: Beijing Haidian District Audio & Video Art Service Center.

Legal representative: Lin Changhong, Manager of Beijing Haidian District Audio & Video Art Service Center.

The plaintiff, Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House, filed an action with the Beijing Haidian District People's Court on the ground that the defendant, Beijing Haidian District Audio & Video Art Service Center, had infringed its exclusive publication and distribution right of audio tapes.

The plaintiff alleged: In October 1990, the plaintiff lawfully obtained the exclusive publication and distribution right of the cassette tape of the theme songs of the TV series *Lülu, Women and the Well* (hereinafter referred to as the "*Well*" series), and formally published and distributed it in March 1991. In April 1991, without the plaintiff's permission, the defendant arbitrarily copied 600 cassettes of the *Well* series tapes and issued and sold them in the name of Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House, seriously infringing the plaintiff's exclusive publication and distribution right and causing certain economic losses to the plaintiff. Therefore, the plaintiff requests that the defendant make a public apology and compensate for the economic losses incurred thereby.

The defendant argued: The defendant credulously believed the representation of Jiang, a business clerk of China Film Publishing House, that he possessed the master tape and color covers of the theme songs of the *Well* series and a letter of authorization from the publishing house, and thought that the *Well* series tapes were purchased through normal channels. After the defendant had copied 600 cassettes and learned that the covers were fake, it immediately stopped recording. The defendant sincerely accepts criticism and agrees to compensate the plaintiff for its losses and make a public apology.

After public trial of the case, the Beijing Haidian District People's Court found:

In October 1990, Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House, Dalian Television Station, and the lyricist and composer of the theme songs of the *Well* series, Zhang Li and Xu Peidong, entered into a contract for the publication and distribution of the cassette tape of the theme songs of the *Well* series. The contract provided that the master tape of the cassette tape of the theme songs of the *Well* series and the rights of reproduction, publication, and distribution at home and abroad were vested in Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House and Dalian Television Station; the term of the contract was four years. After the contract was signed, Dalian Television Station commissioned Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House to organize the publication and distribution of the cassette tape of the *Well* series and to handle all related matters. Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House thereby obtained the exclusive publication and distribution right of the cassette tape of the theme songs of the *Well* series, and reported to the National Copyright Administration for examination and registration. On February 11, 1991, the parties to the contract jointly published a statement in the *Press and Publishing News*, declaring that within the term of the contract, no entity or individual might, without permission, reproduce, publish, or distribute audio and video products of the theme songs of the *Well* series. In March 1991, Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House formally published and distributed the cassette tape of the theme songs of the *Well* series. At the same time, the National Copyright Administration issued the *Notice on Respecting the Copyright of the Theme Songs of the TV Series "Lülu, Women and the Well"*, reminding all audio and video publishing entities in the country not to arrange the publication of audio recordings of the series, so as to protect the legitimate rights and interests of the copyright owners.

In April 1991, the defendant, Beijing Haidian District Audio & Video Art Service Center, purchased from Jiang (already subjected to administrative sanctions) of China Film Publishing House 2,000 sets of color covers (with A and B stickers) of the cassette tape of the theme songs of the *Well* series, and using a cassette tape of the theme songs of the *Well* series purchased from the market as the master tape, without the permission of Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House, reproduced 600 cassettes of the *Well* series, of which 565 cassettes were sold. Thereafter, upon report by others, the case was discovered by the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Radio and Television, which confiscated over 100 cassettes recovered after sales, and detained 1,400 unused sets of color covers and one Sony duplicator (the cassettes, color covers, and duplicator have been disposed of by the administrative authority).

The Beijing Haidian District People's Court held: The act of Beijing Haidian District Audio & Video Art Service Center in purchasing color covers for the cassette tape of the *Well* series from a private individual, using a cassette tape of the theme songs of the *Well* series purchased on the market as the master tape, and arbitrarily reproducing the cassette tape of the theme songs of the *Well* series formally published by Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House, in accordance with Article 118 of the *General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China*, infringed the exclusive publication and distribution right of Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House to the audio tape of the theme songs of the *Well* series, and shall bear civil liability for infringement.

During the trial, Haidian District Audio & Video Art Service Center apologized in court to Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House, and agreed to publicly apologize in newspapers and compensate for the economic losses incurred thereby.

On the basis of having ascertained the facts and distinguished right from wrong, and in accordance with the provision of Article 128 of the *Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China* that "mediation may also be conducted if it is possible before judgment", with the consent of both parties, the Haidian District People's Court conducted mediation. On May 27, 1991, the parties voluntarily reached the following agreement:

(1) Beijing Haidian District Audio & Video Art Service Center shall immediately cease its infringement of the exclusive publication right of Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House to the cassette tape of the theme songs of *Lülu, Women and the Well*, and shall publish in the *Press and Publishing News* and the *Beijing Daily* an apology letter approved by this court, publicly apologizing to Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House (to be performed within 10 days after the mediation document becomes effective);

(2) Beijing Haidian District Audio & Video Art Service Center shall compensate Dalian Audio & Video Publishing House for economic losses in the amount of RMB 22,070.

Litigation costs of RMB 930 shall be borne by Beijing Haidian District Audio & Video Art Service Center.
